title: Four long-context text models added
summary:
Four long-context models joined the API, Enter got a clearer front door, and model routing received some necessary patience.

Quest contributions added GLM-5.3 FlashX and Claude Opus 5.5; the team added GPT-6 Sol and Luna. All four are paid-only, accept text and images, and support tools and reasoning or thinking. Their context windows reach roughly one million tokens. The generated API docs now list Sol and Luna.

Sign-in, app authorization, device approval, keys, and top-ups now use more consistent screens and guidance. Key forms gained model search and filtering, while the Models, Agents, and MCP catalog tabs returned with reorganized cards and clearer controls.

The community catalog added Aizen, an Arabic, right-to-left TTS web app. The README also refreshed its recent news and star-history charts.

highlights.title: GLM-5.3 FlashX joins
highlights.text: Use `z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx` with text, up to 10 reference images, tools, and reasoning across a 1,048,576-token context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx).

highlights.title: Claude Opus 5.5 joins
highlights.text: Use `anthropic/claude-opus-5.5` with text, up to 20 reference images, tools, and adaptive thinking in a 1M-token context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=anthropic/claude-opus-5.5).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Sol joins
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-6-sol` for text and image input, tools, and reasoning with up to 1,050,000 tokens of context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6-sol).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Luna joins
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-6-luna` for text and image input, tools, and reasoning with up to 1,050,000 tokens of context. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6-luna).

highlights.title: A clearer Enter
highlights.text: Search and filter models while setting key permissions, and browse the restored Models, Agents, and MCP tabs. Sign-in and authorization screens now give clearer guidance too. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
